defect: The change adds a debugging override 'key.cullMode = VK_CULL_MODE_NONE' right after the cull mode is computed, so culling is always disabled and back faces are drawn.
reason: The fix removes exactly these two added lines to re-enable culling, and the override is plainly visible (and marked TODO: Remove) in the diff.

defect: The fix changes the new sampler's maxLod from 1000.0f to 0.0f while the Vulkan texture path was still a stub; maxLod 1000 (VK_LOD_CLAMP_NONE) is the standard unclamped value and is clamped to the view's levels anyway.
reason: This is a work-in-progress tuning tweak in an unfinished backend, not the repair of a demonstrable defect in the added sampler code.

defect: The new early 'return;' after a short fread of the ZIM data in ReplacedTexture::Load leaks the FILE handle opened at the top of the function.
reason: The fix adds fclose(fp) before that return (the PNG-path returns it also patches were pre-existing), and the open FILE and missing fclose are visible in the hunk.

defect: The fix delays Atrac3+ context creation until the first Decode so SetChannels can switch mono tracks; this change only renamed log categories (ME to Log::ME).
reason: The mono-playback bug came from the earlier refactor #19033 named in the fix message, not from this logging-API rename.

defect: The new DoBlockTransfer computes dstBasePtr and dstStride from transfersrc/transfersrcw instead of transferdst/transferdstw (copy-paste), so block transfers copy onto the source.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these two added lines with the dst fields, and the copy-paste error is obvious in the diff.

defect: The fix inserts a missing pad register before transfersize and corrects the trailing pad array size in GPUgstate; this change only changed 'int nop' to 'u32 nop' and reformatted the transfersize line.
reason: The missing padding and wrong pad05 size already existed before this change, which left the struct layout unchanged.

defect: CConfig::Save now returns early when iniFile.Load fails, so when no ini exists yet (first run) the config is never written.
reason: The fix removes exactly that added 'return;', and a reviewer can see from the diff that a missing ini file aborts saving.

defect: The fix passes explicit true/false for useHWTransform to GetShaders in the hardware and software paths; this change only renamed lastVTypeID_ to lastVType_ in those calls.
reason: The useHWTransform argument and the shader selection logic were not altered by this change, so the repaired behaviour is not in its lines.

defect: The change moves CLUT lookup in the software sampler to SamplerID::cached.clut, but the debugger's GetCurrentTexture builds a SamplerID via ComputeSamplerID without setting cached.clut, so the sampler dereferences a null CLUT pointer and crashes.
reason: The fix sets id.cached.clut in Rasterizer.cpp and makes the new union const for that assignment, repairing a crash this change introduced; seeing it requires the sampler and debugger code in other files.

defect: In the new Comp_Vsgn, XMM0 is zeroed once before the loop, but CMPEQSS/ANDNPS overwrite it each iteration, so later elements compare against garbage instead of 0.0f.
reason: The fix moves the XORPS inside the loop, and the clobbering of XMM0 is visible within the added function.

defect: The new rewind branch in scePsmfPlayerStart sets readSize = size - mpegoffset and then immediately overwrites it with readSize = 0.
reason: The fix deletes the stray overwrite line added by this change, and the dead assignment is visible in the diff.

defect: The new stubs sceNpAuth_A1DE86F8 and sceNpService_0F8F5821 log themselves as 'sceNpAuth_4EC1F667' (copy-paste), producing misleading logs.
reason: The fix corrects the two log strings added by this change, and the wrong names are directly visible next to the function names in the diff.

defect: The moved debug statistic computes lastBufSize_ as (indexR - m_indexW) & INDEX_MASK, reversing the old (m_indexW - m_indexR) subtraction, so the displayed buffer fill level is wrong.
reason: The fix replaces this line with ((indexW - indexR) & INDEX_MASK) / 2, and the swapped operands are visible against the removed line in the diff.

defect: The fix rewrites the 16-bit to 8888 conversions (ARGB8From565/5551 and the 4444 loop) used for D3D9 uploads; this change moved those routines verbatim from ColorConv.h and FramebufferDX9.cpp.
reason: The wrong conversions existed before this extraction, which copied them unchanged.

defect: The fix fixes the 16-bit format conversions in MakePixelTexture and renames the 8888 call to ConvertRGBA8888ToBGRA8888, which is a macro alias of the same function.
reason: This change only replaced the symmetric RGBA2BGRA loops with the equivalent helper; the broken 565/5551/4444 code was untouched context.

defect: The fix offsets the crash-screen text by the display safe insets for notched phones; the hard-coded x=20, y=50 origin predates this change.
reason: Ignoring safe insets was pre-existing layout behaviour, and making the new right column follow x is a layout improvement, not a repair of these lines.

defect: The fix implements sceSas outputMode handling and replaces volumeLeftSend/RightSend with effectLeft/Right; this change rewrote PCM looping and bumped the SasVoice savestate version.
reason: The output-mode and send-buffer behaviour fixed later is unrelated to the lines this change added.

defect: The fix calls fbo_destroy before clearing framebuffer->fbo in non-buffered mode; the change only renamed entry->framebuffer to the new framebuffer parameter there.
reason: Setting fbo to 0 without destroying it existed before this change, which preserved the logic.

defect: The new rpTypeDebugNames table lists INPUT variants that the RenderPassType enum at this commit does not have (DEPTH=1, MULTIVIEW=2, MULTISAMPLE=4, BACKBUFFER=8), so most render passes get the wrong debug name.
reason: The fix removes the INPUT entries from the table added here; the mismatch needs the enum in VulkanFramebuffer.h to see.

defect: ADSREnvelope::Step now calls WalkCurve(type_) unconditionally before the state switch, so the envelope keeps walking (using stale rate_/type_, since SetState(STATE_OFF) returns early) even in STATE_OFF.
reason: The fix moves WalkCurve back into the four active-state cases, and the change in behaviour for STATE_OFF is visible in the diff.

defect: The new ImWatchWindow::Draw passes &cfg.atracToolOpen to ImGui::Begin instead of &cfg.watchOpen, so closing the Watch window toggles the Atrac tool flag instead.
reason: The fix changes exactly this pointer to cfg.watchOpen, and the wrong flag is visible in the added code next to the new watchOpen setting.

defect: The fix only restyles brace placement throughout sceNet.cpp.
reason: Pure style changes are not a defect repair.

defect: The fix joins the InitFromRenderThread signature onto one line to remove accidental extra indentation.
reason: Pure formatting change, no defect.

defect: The fix drops the (int) cast in 'mr[r].reg == (int)INVALID_REG' after RegMIPS::reg was later retyped from int to ARMReg.
reason: At this change reg was an int, so the cast was correct; the enum/int compare warning arose from a later type change, and the comparison result is the same either way.

defect: The fix retunes audio constants (sample rate 44100 to 48000, channel queue factors 4/2 to 12/1) to reduce distortion.
reason: This is parameter tuning (the 48000 rate was later reverted to 44100), not a repair of an identifiable defect in this change's lines.

defect: The fix makes HandleFault also handle an invalid host address (all ones) from unaligned SIMD accesses; this change only added explicit casts to silence conversion warnings.
reason: Handling the new fault kind is new robustness behaviour, not a defect introduced by the casts.

defect: The fix removes QCOM_binning_control detection because using the extension crashes Adreno GPUs; this change only added the detection flag.
reason: Detection itself is harmless; the crashing usage (hints) came from a later commit, and the fix is a feature removal.

defect: The fix removes the GL_QCOM_binning_control defines that this change renamed with a GL_ prefix.
reason: Renaming the defines introduced no defect; the later removal drops the extension support as a whole.

defect: The combo-key list names the renamed key 'FastForward' while the KeyMap name, touch-control label and translation key use 'Fast-forward', so the combo key label is not translated.
reason: The fix changes this added string to 'Fast-forward' to match the translation key; the inconsistency is only visible against KeyMap.cpp and the lang files.

defect: The added early 'return' when the pointer is in analogPointerMask skips all touch processing, including TOUCH_UP, so a D-pad or button that grabbed the pointer before the overlapping stick never releases it.
reason: The fix removes these early returns and instead only refuses to acquire analog pointers on TOUCH_MOVE, and the skipped release handling is visible in the diff.

defect: The new logicOps lookup table is not in GE logic-op enum order (CLEAR, AND, AND_REVERSE, COPY, ...), so most PSP logic ops map to the wrong GL logic op.
reason: The fix reorders the table added by this change; confirming the order needs the GELogicOp enum values from ge_constants.h.

defect: The fix in this file changes '(flags & TO_INT) || (flags & TO_FLOAT)' to '(flags & TO_INT)', which is a no-op since TO_FLOAT is 0; the actual rounding fix is in ArmCompFPU.cpp.
reason: The edit to this change's line does not alter behaviour, so it repairs no defect here.

defect: The fix adds vertex previews for fans, strips and lines and guards the texture view with 'if (tex)'.
reason: The extra primitive types are a feature, and the null texture was already dereferenced by GetNativeTextureView before this change.

defect: When consolidating the UMD type into the header, the change sets PSP_UMD_TYPE_GAME to 0x00 although the removed #define in sceUmd.cpp was 0x10, so games report the wrong UMD type.
reason: The fix restores 0x10, and the previous value is only visible in the sceUmd.cpp part of the change.

defect: The new FastLoadBoneMatrix dirties the next bone matrix with '(DIRTY_BONEMATRIX0 << (num / 12)) + 1', adding 1 to a bit flag instead of setting the next bit, so the wrong uniform is dirtied.
reason: The fix replaces this with DIRTY_BONEMATRIX0 << ((mtxNum + 1) & 7); adding 1 to a shifted flag is visibly wrong in the diff.

defect: The change uses 'auto framebuffers = framebufferManager_->Framebuffers();', which copies the vector returned by const reference on every texture attach and CLUT load, causing slowdowns.
reason: The fix binds it as a const reference; the copy is only evident from the const-reference return type in FramebufferManagerCommon.h.

defect: The fix corrects LBN size parsing (find('_') + 5 to find('_size') + 7) in parseLBN.
reason: The faulty parsing was moved verbatim from OpenFile into parseLBN, so it predates this change.

defect: The added check returns SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDR when outAddr is invalid, although a null outAddr is valid and used to skip decoded data.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added check; that null is legitimate is visible only from _AtracDecodeData's 'if (out != NULL)' handling outside the hunk, or from hardware tests.

defect: The new PSPStickDragDrop::SetSpacing stores s/3 but GetSpacing returns spacing_ unscaled, so get/set do not round-trip and resizing the analog head drifts.
reason: The fix makes GetSpacing return spacing_ * 3, and the asymmetric pair is visible in the added class.

defect: The fix adds begin/end callback handling for lwmutex waits and drops the callback check on successful lock in sceKernelLockLwMutexCB.
reason: This change only swapped __KernelForceCallbacks for hleCheckCurrentCallbacks; processing callbacks on lock was pre-existing behaviour, and the wait-within-wait support is new.
